name: Being Free
overview: Scripture reveals that true freedom is found in Christ, who liberates believers from the bondage of sin and spiritual darkness. Jesus promises that those who abide in His word are His true disciples and that if the Son sets them free, they are free indeed. This freedom is closely tied to the forgiveness of sins, which is made possible through faith, repentance, and baptism, enabling believers to move from distress and captivity into a life marked by light, sanctification, and inheritance in God’s kingdom.
